condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: GMC versus MCS server subscription procedure
claims.conclusion: GMC covers group documents and/or GKTPs elements; MCS server covers group documents. Constituent-group GMS has a distinct subscriber procedure.
Request-URI is configured GMS subscription-proxy public service identity, not the XCAP resource URI.
resource-lists MIME body has one entry per resource, with relative reference based on configured XCAP root; group-ID document or GKTP document plus GKTPs node selector.

Include acquired access token; if identity hiding is required, protect both mcptt-info and resource-lists MIME bodies for confidentiality/integrity and include MIKEY body with CSK. Referenced mechanisms not reproduced here.
MC-service agnostic despite historical MCPTT names in service-specific bodies/headers.

limitations: Not a complete SUBSCRIBE template; service/Contact requirements and dependent SIP/event procedures must also be satisfied.
TS24.482 authentication and TS24.379 protection dependencies not independently checked.
